tldr: Headlines across all outlets frame the Swiss referendum as a clear voter rejection of proposed stricter neutrality rules. Wire services and Ukrainian press uniquely foreground the NATO-cooperation and Russia-sanctions stakes, while RT frames the story around the Swiss government's own opposition to the initiative.
